video_title: Will Asteroid 2024 YR4 Hit the Moon in 2032?
author: @TheDudeGuy-5o
text: I don't think if it impact the moon it will cause much damage to the moon
draft: Fair point — NASA said an impact wouldn't alter the Moon's orbit. A 60-metre rock would still blast out a fresh crater, though Webb observations now show it'll miss by 21,200 km on 22 December 2032.
source: NASA Planetary Defense blog (5 Jun 2025, cited in owb_ar1_2024_yr4_moon/PACKAGE_MANIFEST.json): 'would not alter the Moon's orbit'; SCRIPTS_AND_PACKAGING_v02.md S1.2 & NASA Webb (2 Apr 2025) / 2024 YR4 Facts: ~60 m wide (53-67 m, 15-storey building); CHIEF_H40_VO_LOCK.md line 12 & S1.3 (NASA Planetary Defense, 5 Mar 2026): misses by 21,200 km on 22 Dec 2032.
